rationale: This article in Teaching Sociology examines the design and maintenance of social science computer laboratories for teaching and learning. It is completely unrelated to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01: wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings yield exclude because the paper concerns university social science computer labs for pedagogy rather than water or sanitation services or related governance mechanisms.

evidence_quotes.quote: Social science computer labs as sites for teaching and learning: Challenges and solutions in their design and maintenance
